DIA of %1$f too short - using %2$f instead!
Glucodynamic model for Lyumjev U100 (standard concentration); This model automatically adjusts the duration of insulin action (DIA).
Experimental Traffic Jam Glucodynamic model. Uses a unified 8-hour analytic depot pool to calculate dynamic Subcutaneous accumulation.
Absorption Speed, New Site Speed and Ramp, Dose Interaction, CGM Lag, Pulse Size and Bolus Speed

How fast your infusion site absorbs insulin once it has settled. 1 is standard, 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 half as fast. Only absorption from the site changes, not how long insulin acts in serum. Default 1.

How fast a new site absorbs right after a site change, compared with a settled site. It rises to full speed over New Site Ramp. Default 0.47, from the pump study the model is fitted to. 1 turns it off.
How many hours a new site takes to reach full speed, rising linearly from New Site Speed. Default 48 hours: day 1 to day 3 of the pump study.

How much doses slow each other down when they accumulate at the site. 1: all insulin at the site absorbs together, more slowly the more there is. 0: every dose absorbs on its own. Values in between mix the two. Default 1.
How much insulin your pump gives in one pulse during a bolus. Default 0.05 U.
How fast your pump gives a bolus. Default 1.5 U/min.
How many minutes your CGM lags behind your blood glucose. Default 8 minutes. 0 turns it off.
